            tar.createinfo(name=m['path'], mode=m['mode'], type=tarfile.REGTYPE)
        
        tar.close()
        
        tar_data = tar_buf.getvalue()
        
        # Gzip compress
        compressed = gzip.compress(tar_data)
        
        # Calculate sha256
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest()
        
        # Build result
        result = {
            "format": "tar+gzip",
            "bundle_b64": base64.b64encode(compressed).decode(),
            "sha256": sha256
        }
        
        print(json.dumps(result))
    except (ValueError, Exception):
        print(json.dumps({"error": "invalid_request"}))
